caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain off-white background. On the right side is a wooden goblet-like vessel, rendered in shades of brown with visible wood grain and concentric rings. The vessel has a wide, circular rim with a noticeable chip and a deep bowl; it sits on a thick, rounded stem with a bulbous central section, above a circular base. On the left side of the drawing, there is a small, dark-colored object resembling a turned wooden pestle or stopper, oriented horizontally with its broader end facing left and a flat, circular end featuring a lighter, gold-colored top facing right. Both objects are detailed with careful shading to reflect their three-dimensional forms, and the artist's signature "C Marshall" is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Sand Box and Seal
